pairs.target: chuāng biān zhǐyǒu mǐlā , yīwén de yǐzi shàng luò zhe liǎngběnshū .
pairs.english: Only Mira was by the window; two books were stacked on Iven's chair.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边只有米拉，伊文的椅子上摞着两本书。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒujìn shí , tā zhèng yòng yá yǎozhù yì jié xiàntóu , liǎngshǒu yā zhe yíkuài mùpiàn , hánhánhuhū dì jiào tā bāngmáng .
pairs.english: As Tavi approached, she was gripping a length of thread between her teeth, both hands pressing a wooden offcut, and mumbling for him to help.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走近时，她正用牙咬住一截线头，两手压着一块木片，含含糊糊地叫他帮忙。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu qù jiē mùpiàn , tā què yáotóu , cháo zìjǐ de zuǐ nǔ le nǔ .
pairs.english: He reached to take the wood, but she shook her head, gesturing toward her own mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手去接木片，她却摇头，朝自己的嘴努了努。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo niēzhù nà jié xiàn , bǎ tā cóng tā yá jiān chōuchūlái .
pairs.english: He had to pinch that thread and pull it from her teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 他只好捏住那截线，把它从她牙间抽出来。

pairs.target: " jiǎnzi . "
pairs.english: “Scissors.”
pairs.hanzi: “剪子。”

pairs.target: mǐlā zhōngyú néng shuōhuà le .
pairs.english: Mira could finally speak.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉终于能说话了。

pairs.target: " jiù zài nǐ shǒubiān . "
pairs.english: “Right there beside your hand.”
pairs.hanzi: “就在你手边。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná qǐ jiǎnzi , tì tā jiǎnqí liǎngduān .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up the scissors and trimmed both ends for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿起剪子，替她剪齐两端。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng fàng zhe zuótiān nà zhāng tiān guò zhījià de tú , pángbiān shì jǐkuài fèi mùliào .
pairs.english: On the table lay yesterday's drawing of the added support; beside it were several scraps of wood.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上放着昨天那张添过支架的图，旁边是几块废木料。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu zhàozhe tú lìkè kāi zuò , zhī zài mùpiàn shàng huà le liǎnggè bùtóng de cáokǒu , ná xiàn bǐ nǎ yìzhǒng bǎng fǎ bù dǎng shǒu .
pairs.english: Mira did not immediately start building from the drawing; she only drew two different notches on the offcut, using thread to compare which way of tying would leave hands clear.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有照着图立刻开做，只在木片上画了两个不同的槽口，拿线比哪一种绑法不挡手。

pairs.target: tā jiào tǎ wéi bāng zhe ànzhù yìbiān , zìjǐ yòng zhǐjiān yán mùpiàn huáguòqù .
pairs.english: She asked Tavi to help hold one side while she herself traced along the wood with a fingertip.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫塔维帮着按住一边，自己用指尖沿木片划过去。

pairs.target: xiàn jié tūqǐlái , zhǐjiǎ pèng le yíxià , tā biàn bǎ nàzhǒng bǎng fǎ huàdiào .
pairs.english: The knot stuck up; her nail caught it once, so she crossed out that way of tying.
pairs.hanzi: 线结凸起来，指甲碰了一下，她便把那种绑法划掉。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiàwǔ qù nǎér le ? "
pairs.english: “Where did you go this afternoon?”
pairs.hanzi: “你下午去哪儿了？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō qù ná tú , huà dào zhèlǐ biàn rěnbúzhù , bǎ mǎtóu hé nài lěi de xīn xiǎngfǎ yě shuō le .
pairs.english: Tavi said he'd gone to collect a map, and at this point he could not resist telling her about the landing and Nerai's new idea too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说去拿图，话到这里便忍不住，把码头和奈蕾的新想法也说了。

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng wán , xiān wèn nǎ tiān .
pairs.english: Having heard him out, Mira first asked what day.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉听完，先问哪天。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu .
pairs.english: He shook his head.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头。

pairs.target: zài wèn qù nǎér , tā háishì yáotóu .
pairs.english: Asked next where, he still shook his head.
pairs.hanzi: 再问去哪儿，他还是摇头。

pairs.target: " lǎoshī dāying le ? "
pairs.english: “Has the instructor agreed?”
pairs.hanzi: “老师答应了？”

pairs.target: " hái méi wèn . "
pairs.english: “Haven't asked yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没问。”

pairs.target: mǐlā sōngkāi xiàn , kào huí yǐbèi , dīng zhe tā kàn le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Mira let go of the thread, leaned back against the chair and stared at him a while.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉松开线，靠回椅背，盯着他看了一会儿。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ zěnme xiàng míngzǎo jiùyào chūmén ? "
pairs.english: “Then why do you look as though you are leaving tomorrow morning?”
pairs.hanzi: “那你怎么像明早就要出门？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu , kànjiàn zìjǐ yǐjīng bǎ tā sàn zài zhuōbiān de mùpiàn lǐ chéng le yíluò .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down and saw he had already sorted her scattered wooden pieces at the table edge into a stack.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头，看见自己已经把她散在桌边的木片理成了一摞。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zuì shàngmiàn nà kuài fàng huíqù , shuō zhǐshì juéde zhècì yěxǔ néng zuò diǎn zhēnzhèng de huó .
pairs.english: He put the top piece back, saying he just felt this time he might be able to do some real work.
pairs.hanzi: 他把最上面那块放回去，说只是觉得这次也许能做点真正的活。

pairs.target: mǐlā ná qǐ nà kuài mùpiàn , méi lìjí jiē huà .
pairs.english: Mira picked up that piece of wood without immediately replying.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿起那块木片，没立即接话。

pairs.target: zǒuláng lǐ yǒurén tuō zhe dèngzi guòqù , dèng jiǎo zài shí dìshàng duànduànxùxù dì xiǎng .
pairs.english: Someone dragged a stool past in the corridor, its legs rattling intermittently on the stone floor.
pairs.hanzi: 走廊里有人拖着凳子过去，凳脚在石地上断断续续地响。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhèlǐ yě shì zhēnde . "
pairs.english: “My work here is real too.”
pairs.hanzi: “我这里也是真的。”

pairs.target: tā de shēngyīn bú dà .
pairs.english: Her voice was quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 她的声音不大。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìshí bùzhī zěnme jiěshì .
pairs.english: For a moment Tavi did not know how to explain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一时不知怎么解释。

pairs.target: tā bìng méiyǒu bǎ zhèxiē mùpiàn kànqīng , kě tā gāngcái hái yǎo zhe xiàntóu děng tā , tā què yǐjīng xiǎngzhe lìng yìtiáo lù .
pairs.english: He certainly did not dismiss these wooden pieces, but she had just been waiting for him with thread between her teeth, while he was already thinking of another road.
pairs.hanzi: 他并没有把这些木片看轻，可她刚才还咬着线头等他，他却已经想着另一条路。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì shuō zhège méiyòng . "
pairs.english: “I am not saying this is useless.”
pairs.hanzi: “我不是说这个没用。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “I know.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ mùpiàn bǎipíng .
pairs.english: She laid the wood flat.
pairs.hanzi: 她把木片摆平。

pairs.target: " dàn nǐ gāngcái méi tīngjiàn wǒ wèn bǎng nǎ yìbiān . "
pairs.english: “But just now you didn't hear me ask which side to tie.”
pairs.hanzi: “但你刚才没听见我问绑哪一边。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànkàn xiàn , shì zhe zhǐ yòucè , mǐlā lìkè yòngshǒuzhǎng cóng nàlǐ tuīguòqù , jié tóu gè zài zhǎng gēn .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the thread and tentatively pointed right; Mira immediately slid her palm through there, and the knot dug into the heel of her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看看线，试着指右侧，米拉立刻用手掌从那里推过去，结头硌在掌根。

pairs.target: " nǐ kàn . "
pairs.english: “You see.”
pairs.hanzi: “你看。”

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu shōuhuí lái , liǎnshàng yǒudiǎn rè .
pairs.english: He drew his hand back, his face a little hot.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手收回来，脸上有点热。

pairs.target: yīwén huílái shí , kànjiàn liǎnggè rén gè ànzhe mùpiàn yìduān , wèn tāmen shìbushì zài děng shuí xuānbù shèngfù .
pairs.english: Returning, Iven saw both of them holding an end of the wood each and asked whether they were waiting for someone to announce the winner.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文回来时，看见两个人各按着木片一端，问他们是不是在等谁宣布胜负。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō děng tǎ wéi cóng mǎtóu huílái , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ shìqíng cóngtóu yòu shuō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Mira said they were waiting for Tavi to come back from the landing, so Tavi told the story from the beginning once again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说等塔维从码头回来，塔维便把事情从头又说了一遍。

pairs.target: zhècì tā shuō de mànxiē , xiān shuōmíng méiyǒu dìngxià rìqī hé dìfāng .
pairs.english: This time he spoke more slowly, first explaining that no date or place had been settled.
pairs.hanzi: 这次他说得慢些，先说明没有定下日期和地方。

pairs.target: yīwén zuò dào nà luò shū páng , tīngdào " duǎnchéng " cái xiào qǐlái , shuō zhìshǎo búbì xiànzài tǎolùn gěi shuí xiě yíshū .
pairs.english: Iven sat beside the books in that stack, only laughing at “short trip,” saying at least they need not discuss now whom to write farewell letters to.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文坐到那摞书旁，听到“短程”才笑起来，说至少不必现在讨论给谁写遗书。

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng xiàntóu tán le tā yíxià .
pairs.english: Mira flicked him once with the thread end.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用线头弹了他一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tāmen yàoshi yuànyì , néng bunéng yě yìqǐ qù .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether they could go together too, if they wanted.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问他们要是愿意，能不能也一起去。

pairs.target: huà gāng chūkǒu , tā zìjǐ xiān tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: The words had only just left his mouth when he himself stopped first.
pairs.hanzi: 话刚出口，他自己先停住了。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe tā , děng tā shuōwán hòu bànjù .
pairs.english: Iven watched him, waiting for him to finish the rest of the sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看着他，等他说完后半句。

pairs.target: " wǒ bù zhīdào néng bunéng dài rén . "
pairs.english: “I don't know whether I can bring anyone.”
pairs.hanzi: “我不知道能不能带人。”

pairs.target: " nǐ lián zìjǐ néng bunéng qù dōu bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “You do not even know whether you can go yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: “你连自己能不能去都不知道。”

pairs.target: mǐlā shuōwán , yòu bǎ xiàn dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Having said that, Mira handed him the thread again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说完，又把线递给他。

pairs.target: " zhèbiān , xiān ànzhù . "
pairs.english: “This side, hold it first.”
pairs.hanzi: “这边，先按住。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yīyán àn jǐn , děng tā yòng shǒutuī guò liǎngbiàn , cái sōngkāi zhǐtou .
pairs.english: Tavi pressed firmly as asked, waited for her hand to slide past twice, and only then loosened his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维依言按紧，等她用手推过两遍，才松开指头。

pairs.target: zhèhuí xiàn jié cáng zài mùpiàn xiàmiàn , méiyǒu pèngdào tā de shǒu .
pairs.english: This time the knot was tucked beneath the wood and did not touch her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 这回线结藏在木片下面，没有碰到她的手。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ bǎng fǎ huà zài tú jiǎo , xiěxià rìqī , méiyǒu shuō zhèyàng jiù chéng le .
pairs.english: Mira drew the tying method in the corner of the diagram and wrote the date, without claiming that this meant success.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把绑法画在图角，写下日期，没有说这样就成了。

alignment.english: in the corner of the diagram

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zìjǐ de shū bào zǒu , téngchū yǐzi , què méi lìkè zuò .
pairs.english: Iven carried away his own books and freed up the chair, but did not sit immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把自己的书抱走，腾出椅子，却没立刻坐。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe chuāngwài liàng qǐlái de dēng , hūrán wèn tǎ wéi , nàxiē chuán yèlǐ hái zǒu bu zǒu .
pairs.english: Watching the lamps light up outside the window, he suddenly asked Tavi whether those boats still travelled at night.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着窗外亮起来的灯，忽然问塔维，那些船夜里还走不走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méi wèn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he hadn't asked.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没问。

pairs.target: " xiàhuí jì zhe wèn . "
pairs.english: “Remember to ask next time.”
pairs.hanzi: “下回记着问。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō de hěn suíyì , mǐlā què táitóu kàn le tā yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Iven spoke quite casually, but Mira lifted her head for a glance at him.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说得很随意，米拉却抬头看了他一眼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ nà jié jiǎnxiàlái de xiàn rào zài zhǐ jiān , dāying le .
pairs.english: Tavi wound that cut-off thread between his fingers and agreed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把那截剪下来的线绕在指间，答应了。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn de língshēngxiǎngqǐ lái , tā děng mǐlā shōu hǎo tú , sāngè réncái yìqǐ líkāi chuāng biān .
pairs.english: The dinner bell rang; he waited for Mira to put the drawing away before all three left the window together.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭的铃声响起来，他等米拉收好图，三个人才一起离开窗边。
